incident-bot: :warning: PagerDuty: metering-pipeline-lag fired (high) — incident runbook: /runbooks/metering/pipeline-lag
incident-bot: PD link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-67890
maria: saw the page. tagging oncall. kevin, you up? we need initial triage and customer impact assessment
kevin: acked. I'm the oncall for metering this shift. taking lead. currently seeing consumer lag ~150k events, consumer lag increasing for writer group
emily: adding logs from producer side — lots of connection errors to ledger-db: "pq: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser"
emily: stack snippet:
```
2024-04-02T09:12:03Z ERROR ledger_client.go:87 Exec failed: pq: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser
2024-04-02T09:12:04Z WARN retrying write (attempt 3)
```
kevin: that's likely DB pool exhaustion, writers are backing up, causing consumers to pause and Kafka offsets to pile up. scaling consumers will only mask it.
oncall-sre: I'll check DB metrics & active connections. pulling pg_stat_activity now
oncall-sre: found many short-lived retries and a spike in active client connections from writer pods beginning 09:08Z
maria: customer impact — billing, please check for 24h token deltas and flag any customers >5% deviation so we can consider invoice holds
billing: acknowledged, running delta query for last 24h across top 200 customers. will post results in 15m
kevin: mitigation plan: (1) throttle writer concurrency to reduce DB connections (2) add backpressure on proxy (3) scale DB read replica for offloading non-critical reads
kevin: applying immediate throttle patch to writer-worker config to reduce parallel writes to 4
kevin: kubectl set env deployment/writer-worker WRITER_CONCURRENCY=4 -n prod
emily: applied change; rolling restart started for writer-worker. logs show graceful shutdown of old workers
oncall-sre: also increasing DB max_connections on standby to absorb burst; coordinating with infra
infra-bot: DB config change submitted: alter system set max_connections = 400; will restart primary during maintenance window (ETA 2h)
kevin: since primary restart is not immediate, we've added queueing and are temporarily disabling non-essential reconciliation jobs to free DB slots
billing: quick update: initial delta pass shows 3 customers with >3% discrepancy: forge.ai +7.1%, acme-inc +3.4%, nova-analytics +0.2% (below threshold)
billing: placing preliminary invoice hold on forge.ai and acme-inc. creating ticket BILL-HOLD-915
sales-rep: pinged account owners for forge.ai and acme-inc. forge.ai is mid-billing cycle; they need priority comms
maria: suggested customer note: "We detected an ingestion delay affecting usage reporting. We're reconciling events and will issue credits if required."
kevin: writer-worker roll completes. logs show fewer connection errors but we still have a backlog; consumer lag down from 150k -> 22k
emily: found duplicated events in staging of the proxy due to retries. risk of double-counting if replays are run without dedupe
kevin: important: before backfilling, run idempotency checks and reconciliation to avoid double credits
kevin: starting controlled backfill for window 09:05-09:20 with dedupe enabled
kevin: cli: /opt/metering/bin/backfill --start '2024-04-02T09:05:00Z' --end '2024-04-02T09:20:00Z' --dedupe
billing: reconcile dry-run for forge.ai shows billed_tokens would reduce by 18,720 tokens after dedupe
billing: recording results and preparing credit memo draft. finance-bot, please note pending credit for approval
finance-bot: Received: draft credit memo queued as CR-2024-117; awaiting manager approval
oncall-sre: muting noisy PD alerts for this incident for 20m while we stabilize (:no_bell:)
incident-bot: PagerDuty: kevin acknowledged the alert
maria: timeline note: root cause appears to be DB connection saturation from a reconciliation job + writer retry storm. immediate mitigations: throttle writers, pause heavy reconciliation, backfill with dedupe, DB tuning
kevin: follow-ups to file: (a) add DB connection saturations to monitoring and alerting (b) implement client-side connection pooling limit (c) add dedupe-by-event-id in backfill tool
billing: forge.ai placed on invoice hold and notified via billing-notify webhook. acme-inc hold pending further review
sales-rep: forge.ai response: appreciative and asking for ETA on credit. I've escalated to finance for faster approval
incident-bot: PagerDuty: metering-pipeline-lag resolved (no active alerts)
kevin: marking operational mitigation as complete. handing to SRE + metering for RCA & postmortem
maria: I'll draft customer comms and post incident summary to INC-2024-567: DB pool exhaustion -> writer retry storm -> consumer lag -> backfill + credits
billing: final: credit memo CR-2024-117 pending manager sign-off; estimated customer impact: forge.ai ~ $X invoice adjustment
kevin: thanks everyone. we'll keep watch for regression for next 4 hours. DM if anything pops up
[system]: thread archived by incident-bot at 2123457920
